parent_domains.justification: Ecological modeling encompasses a wide range of practices that include biomass estimation as it's used to model and understand ecological patterns and processes.

closest_parent_domain.justification: 'Ecological modeling' specifically involves creating models and simulations that can include biomass estimation as part of the ecological processes being simulated, making it the closest parent domain.

child_domains.justification: Density estimation can be a child domain of biomass estimation, especially when estimating the density of biomass in a specific area.

closest_child_domain.justification: Density estimation is closely related to biomass estimation as it often serves as a foundational step in calculating the biomass of an area, especially regarding the spatial distribution aspect.
